en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Sindy Al Qummy who said, ‘Isa Bin Abdul Rahman narrated to us from his father saying,

‘Ibn Ukasha Bin Mihsan Al-Asady came over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was standing in his<sup>asws</sup> presence. So he placed forward some grapes to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘One seed by one seed eats an aged old man and a young child eats three and four (at a time, as well as) the one who thinks he is not satiated, and (you) eat two by two, for it is recommended’.

So he said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘For which thing are you<sup>asws</sup> not getting Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> to be married, for he<sup>asws</sup> was reached the marriageable age?’ He (the narrator) said, ‘And in front of him<sup>asws</sup> was a sealed bag, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There would be coming a slave trader from the people of Berbers, and they would be encamping in the house of Maymoun, so we<sup>asws</sup> would buy a slave girl for him<sup>asws</sup> with this bag’.

So there came for that what came, and one day we went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> inform you all about the slave trader whom I<sup>asws</sup> mentioned to you? They have come. So go and buy with this bag, and slave girl from him’. So we went to the slave trader, but he said, ‘I have sold whatever was with me except for two slave girls, both being sick, one of them more favourable than the other’. So we said, ‘Bring them out until we look at them’. So he brought them out, and we said, ‘With how much will you sell to us this more favourable one?’ He said, ‘Seventy Dinars’. We said, ‘Good’.

He said, ‘I will not reduce from Seventy Dinars’. We said to him, ‘We shall buy her from you with this bag, whatever it reaches, and we do not know what is in it’, and there with him a man of white haired and beard. He said, ‘Open it and weight it’. So the slave trader said, ‘Do not open it, for if it is deficient by even one grain from seventy Dinars, I will not sell to you’. So the old man said, ‘Approach’. So we approached and we opened the seal and weighed the Dinars, and there were seventy Dinars, neither more nor less.

So we took the slave girl and brought her over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> was standing in his<sup>asws</sup> presence. So we informed Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> with what had happened. So he<sup>asws</sup> praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and extolled upon Him<sup>azwj</sup>, then said to her: ‘What is your name?’ She said, ‘Hameeda’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Hameeda (praised) in the world, and even more praised in the Hereafter. 
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>! Take her to yourself<sup>asws</sup>’. So she gave birth to the best of the people of the earth, Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>’.
